name: Telegram Spotify Player
description: Turn a Telegram song description into a Spotify search, queue the first match, request next/resume playback and reply with the observed player status.
requirements: Telegram Bot connection and trusted users allowed to control the Spotify account
Spotify Premium connection with playback read/write scopes and an active Spotify device
Configured gpt-4o-mini model service; update the model before its announced January 14, 2027 retirement
recommendationReasons: Queue a Telegram song request and reply with the player state Spotify actually reports.
